integrity.computations: Two Python 3 standard-library programs independently reconstruct all counts using exact Bareiss or CRT/Hadamard determinant methods; one also verifies every reduced path and the other enumerates the smallest nontrivial tours directly.
integrity.proof_basis: A proved degree-one corridor contraction plus the classical directed BEST and matrix-tree theorems; finite experiments are not promoted to a general formula.

scientific_limitations: Evaluated only for height-representation weak orders of sizes 2 through 5.
Counts cyclic rotations as one; does not quotient letter relabelings, reverse order, or switch to rank representation.
Forced-corridor reduction holds for all sizes but no arbitrary-size arborescence evaluation is claimed.
The historical priority of the finite numerical values has not been independently certified.
title: Exact height-word universal-cycle census through five objects
